articles.title: Crypto made new friends in U.S. primaries, but focus now shifts to general election
articles.snippet: Adding Massachusetts incumbent Auchincloss to the list of winning primary candidates Fairshake supported, the industry's influence moves on to November.

articles.title: New Jersey becomes first state to ask Supreme Court to weigh in on prediction markets
articles.snippet: After multiple appeals courts ruled differently about whether states can crack down on prediction markets' sports products, New Jersey asked SCOTUS to step in.

articles.title: The token supercycle: everything of value is becoming programmable
articles.snippet: Tokenization is not just about increasing access to tokens, whatever they may represent, but a fundamental shift in how value is created, owned, financed and moved, argues Solana Foundation’s Lily Liu.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin trades near $77,000, with central bank policy rate decisions taking center stage
articles.snippet: The ADP reported private-sector job growth of just 38,000, missing forecasts and marking the weakest level since January.

articles.title: A China indicator that supports risk-taking in stocks and bitcoin is flashing red
articles.snippet: China's "credit impulse" is flashing red for risk assets. So far, bitcoin has mostly shrugged it off.
